tagline: To make it easy to do business anywhere
hero_kpi_rationale: Alibaba Cloud is the leader in cloud computing in Asia and a strategic growth driver fueled by the rise of generative AI in China, representing an increasing share of the group's valuation

kpis.name: Cloud / AI Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from Alibaba's cloud services and artificial intelligence solutions.
kpis.description: Alibaba Cloud is the largest cloud computing provider in China and Asia. Demand for AI services, particularly generative models and cloud infrastructure, is accelerating its growth.
kpis.signal: Sustained growth driven by enterprise AI adoption

kpis.name: Daily Active Users (all apps)
kpis.explanation: Average number of unique users logging in each day to at least one Alibaba Group application.
kpis.description: Measures daily engagement across Taobao, Tmall, Cainiao, Alipay, and other integrated apps. A key indicator of Alibaba's network health.
kpis.signal: Engaged user base growing at a moderate pace

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total group revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin is improving due to better operational efficiency and more profitable growth in cloud and digital services.
kpis.signal: Profitability improvement driven by cost discipline

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (data centers, network)
kpis.explanation: Spending on critical infrastructure, particularly data centers for cloud and AI.
kpis.description: Alibaba is significantly increasing investments in data centers and AI infrastructure to strengthen Alibaba Cloud and its processing capabilities.
kpis.signal: Capex rising sharply to support the AI wave

kpis.name: Advertising Impressions Growth
kpis.explanation: Growth rate of the total number of ads displayed across Alibaba platforms (Taobao, Tmall, etc.).
kpis.description: Growth in advertising impressions reflects a recovery in consumer activity and increased monetization of user traffic.
kpis.signal: Strong rebound in e-commerce advertising demand

kpis.name: R&D Expenses as % of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Share of revenue invested in research and development, particularly in AI and cloud.
kpis.description: Alibaba is increasing R&D spending to develop its generative AI models and cloud infrastructure, competing with Huawei and Tencent.

kpis.name: AI Product Adoption
kpis.explanation: Number of enterprise customers using Alibaba Cloud's generative AI tools.
kpis.description: Alibaba has deployed Qwen, its generative AI model, to tens of thousands of enterprises via Alibaba Cloud, becoming a leader in AI in China.
kpis.signal: Rapid acceleration in AI adoption by Chinese enterprises

kpis.name: Cloud / AI Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from Alibaba's cloud services and artificial intelligence solutions.
kpis.description: Alibaba Cloud is the largest cloud computing provider in China and Asia. Demand for AI services, particularly generative models and cloud infrastructure, is accelerating its growth.
kpis.signal: Sustained growth driven by enterprise AI adoption

ai_positioning.summary: Alibaba is integrating AI across its various businesses, including e-commerce and cloud services. The company uses AI to enhance customer experience and optimize internal operations.
evidence: Hujing Digital Media and Entertainment Group
